# Explore STEAM Education in Virtual Reality!

STEAM VR brings **Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts, and Mathematics (STEAM)** to life through immersive virtual reality experiences. Designed for middle and high school students, the application offers a new way to explore educational concepts through interactive digital environments.
